## Texts and drawings (2)

- **E0307** (text, sure): 日下舊聞考 映清斋、鉴园. 1780s (乾隆 敕撰) · j83:18a · S05. https://github.com/kanripo/KR2k0036/blob/master/KR2k0036_083.txt
  > 玉玲瓏館之南為昭曠亭亭東南為映清齋齋東為鑑園敞宇五楹西嚮北為潄瓊齋其東為師善堂（長春園册）臣等謹案鑑園之後有船塢
  South of 玉玲瓏館: 昭曠亭, then 映清齋; east of it 鑑園, a five-bay range facing west, with 潄瓊齋 and 師善堂, and a boathouse behind.
- **E0324** (description, sure): 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v4, editors' note on 鉴园. 2020 edition · v4 p.107 · S361. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202008/P020200803382796786124.pdf#page=110
  Of 1767, after 趣园 at Yangzhou, on the long lake north-east of 如园. A five-bay open hall faces west; 开益轩 and five-bay 漱琼斋 lie north, 师善堂 east, 芳晖楼 and 绿净榭 south, with a large boat dock behind.

**On the plan:** Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01), labelled 鉴园正宇, 5x1 cells. https://artmuseum.princeton.edu/collections/objects/138657
